high_level_description: This image is a sponsored Instagram post from the account "stonexindia." The post features a black-and-white split image of a person's face. On the left side of the split, there is a close-up of a person with curly hair, wearing a dark jacket. On the right side, there is a stone sculpture of a face with intricate details, including curly hair and a beard. The text overlay on the image reads, "EVERY STONE HAS A FEELING," which is likely part of the campaign message for the brand. Below the image, there is a call-to-action that says, "Visit Instagram Profile
